United Arab Emirates
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Abu Dhabi, U. A. E.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens (Visa shell be issued in Rome):
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport NO
Service/Official biometric passport NO
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
Citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina, holders of diplomatic, official and ordinary passports that are valid for a period not shorter than six months, are exempt from the obligation to obtain a visa for entry, exit, transit and stay in the territory of the United Arab Emirates for a period not longer than ninety (90) days in any period of 180 days, preceding each day of stay.
Citizens of the United Arab Emirates, holders of diplomatic, special, official and ordinary passports that are valid for a period not shorter than six months, are exempt from the obligation to obtain a visa for entry, exit, transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina for a period not longer than of ninety (90) days in any period of 180 days, preceding each day of stay".
